title: S1: Ingest four raw feeds into bronze with control-total checks
body:
As Sales Operations I want every feed loaded exactly as received, with row counts reconciled to the sender's control file, so that we can prove nothing was lost.

- [ ] CRM activities, two vendor sales feeds, rep-code crosswalk, positions
- [ ] All columns as text; lineage columns _source_file / _ingested_at
- [ ] Check: rows loaded = control file rows

title: S1: Conform vendor A and B trades into one fact table
body:
As an analyst I want one trade table regardless of vendor so that flows reconcile to the transfer agent.

- [ ] Net cancel-and-rebill corrections
- [ ] Parse US dates and $-formatted text amounts
- [ ] Map firm names and share-class codes
- [ ] Map rep codes to advisors with effective dates; keep unmapped trades flagged

title: S1: Clean CRM activities (dedupe syncs, 14 spellings -> 4 types)
body:
- [ ] Keep latest sync per activity
- [ ] Standard activity types and touch weights
- [ ] Both date formats parsed

title: S2: KPI semantic layer (kpis.yaml) and AUM bridge mart
body:
As the Head of Distribution I want one definition per KPI, with owner and target, so that every report shows the same number.

- [ ] Metric tree: organic growth -> net flows -> gross / redemptions
- [ ] AUM bridge ties out to the cent
- [ ] KPI dictionary generated from YAML

title: S2: Wholesaler scorecard with goals and conversion
body:
- [ ] Credited sales by territory + channel group
- [ ] Goal attainment from quarterly goals
- [ ] Meeting-to-sale conversion (3-month window)

title: S2: Data-quality gate blocks refresh on error
body:
- [ ] 16 checks with severity
- [ ] Pipeline exits non-zero on an error-severity failure
- [ ] Test proves one bad row blocks the refresh

title: S3: Next-best-action call lists (uplift x ticket)
body:
As a wholesaler I want a ranked list of advisors and the product family to discuss, with reasons, so that my meetings create the most new sales.

- [ ] Propensity baseline + meeting-effect layer
- [ ] Backtest + simulated A/B test vs current coverage
- [ ] Reason codes from model features

title: S3: Redemption early warning watchlist
body:
- [ ] Advisor-month features, 3-month label
- [ ] AUC vs rule-based baseline
- [ ] Watchlist ranked by AUM at risk, with reasons

title: S3: KPI anomaly alerts with root-cause hints
body:
- [ ] Robust z-score vs trailing 12 months
- [ ] Drill-down hints (vendor / rep-code pattern, vacant seat)

title: S4: GenAI call-prep briefs with compliance guardrails
body:
As a wholesaler I want a one-page brief before each meeting; as Compliance I want no promissory language and no invented numbers.

- [ ] Facts gathered with SQL
- [ ] Claude when a key is set, template otherwise
- [ ] Guardrails: banned phrases, number grounding, footer

title: S4: Excel KPI pack, PowerPoint review and web dashboard
body:
- [ ] Live formulas and sparklines in Excel
- [ ] Native editable charts in PowerPoint with takeaway titles
- [ ] Self-contained dashboard on GitHub Pages

title: S4: Spark parity job and Databricks notebook
body:
- [ ] Same SQL on SQLite and Spark
- [ ] CI compares every table
- [ ] Notebook publishes Delta tables

title: Pilot design: randomised call lists by territory
body: Replace the simulated A/B test with a 6-week pilot; measure incremental gross sales per meeting.

title: Tableau Public workbook from the BI extracts
body: Follow docs/tableau-build-guide.md; publish and link from README.
